# Yoerger Renovations

> Yoerger Renovations, LTD. is a locally owned home remodeling and handyman company based in Kent, Ohio 44240, owned by Ryan Yoerger. It serves Summit and Portage counties in Northeast Ohio and gives free written quotes. Cleveland and Cuyahoga County are outside its service area.

- Phone (call or text): (216) 438-3211
- Email: YoergerRenovations@gmail.com
- Based in: Kent, OH 44240
- Towns served: Kent, Stow, Cuyahoga Falls, Hudson, Tallmadge, Munroe Falls, Silver Lake, Akron, Fairlawn, Twinsburg, Macedonia, Northfield, Richfield, Bath, Copley, Green, Streetsboro, Aurora, Ravenna, Brimfield, Rootstown, Mantua, Mogadore, Garrettsville
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61579007753770

## Services

- [Kitchen remodeling in Kent, OH](https://www.yoergerrenovations.com/kitchen-remodeling/): Cabinets, counters, floors and layout, built around how you actually cook.
- [Bathroom remodeling in Kent, OH](https://www.yoergerrenovations.com/bathroom-remodeling/): Showers, tubs, vanities and tile, from a quick refresh to a spa-like retreat.
- [Basement finishing in Kent, OH](https://www.yoergerrenovations.com/basement-finishing/): Family rooms, offices, gyms and guest suites out of space you already own.
- [Deck building in Kent, OH](https://www.yoergerrenovations.com/deck-building/): Composite or wood, new builds or rebuilds, with railings and stairs done right.
- [Living room remodeling in Kent, OH](https://www.yoergerrenovations.com/living-room-remodeling/): New floors, trim, built-ins and lighting for the room everyone ends up in.
- [Handyman services in Kent, OH](https://www.yoergerrenovations.com/handyman-services/): Handyman services available: repairs, small jobs and the punch list you keep putting off.
